item_replacements.reason: R03:P:015B is a model-form limitation and remains represented only in R03:LIMIT:PROXIES; it must not be reused as part of the formal-model item.

methodology_or_test_protocol.content: Repository-level falsification rule specifies precursor variables and bounded delay required for a valid test.
Defines empirical objective, measurement architecture, Λ_E proxy components, accessibility estimation and operational structural-event criterion.
Requires positive, false-positive and false-negative cases; defines temporal validation, rejection tests, survival criteria, dataset philosophy and case-record schema.
Autodiff case specifies candidate measurements, competing explanations, controls and weakening conditions.
Synthetic 1000-transition stress test varies resource dominance, structural signal, proxy noise and ordering under predefined break conditions.
Compares CPB binary classifications on 20 historical transitions against common historical interpretations with a 50% random baseline; source limitation about lack of live raters remains separate.
Defines integration/self-modeling/coordination countercases that would weaken the consciousness hypothesis.
Requires unfamiliar users or systems to use CPB to identify bottlenecks, generate interventions, recognize boundaries or outperform conventional approaches.

assertions_or_hypotheses.content: Case target is manual gradient specification -> automated derivative generation, distinguished from backpropagation and a generic deep-learning transition.
Autodiff is hypothesized to absorb derivative complexity into computational infrastructure.
Describes manual bottleneck and changed workflow after automatic gradient generation.
Predicts description-length absorption, increased aligned information velocity and expanded accessibility.
Source interprets CPB variable mappings and historical timing while acknowledging compute/data contributions.
Source rates the case positively with compute/data confounding and concludes it provides positive evidence for CPB.
Assembly -> compilers is hypothesized as a complexity-absorbing structural transition.
Source maps compiler abstraction to description-length absorption, faster iteration and lower representational distance while acknowledging hardware contribution.
Source concludes assembly -> compilers supports the recurring CPB pattern with hardware confound noted.
Tests whether major capability growth can occur without a prior structural increase in information velocity.
Source describes staged post-2012 scaling and increasingly resource-driven mature-regime gains.
Source rates structural evidence mixed and resource confounding strong.
Source classifies mixed/weak falsification pressure and says CPB is weaker in mature optimization regimes while surviving with refinement.
Proposes basin-opening versus basin-mining/exploitation regimes, historical structural-stack accounting and context-sensitive transition horizons.
Source says the adversarial test identifies a boundary of applicability and narrows the strongest CPB claim toward phase boundaries rather than all capability improvement.
Source interprets the reported agreement and hypothetical kappa-style estimate as a convergent-validity signal overlapping historical intuition.
Source calls the exercise a positive validation signal but not proof and says genuine external testing remains next.
Alpha-beta pruning is hypothesized as a search-geometry transformation that reduces effective search without changing perfect-condition minimax result.
Source maps pruning to efficiency/accessibility gains and reports historical timing/resource-control interpretation.
Source rates the case strongly with low resource confound and concludes it supports CPB.
Document does not claim subjective experience solved and frames itself as a falsifiable computational exploration.
Proposes consciousness-like organization through shared representation, self-modeling, internal coordination and recursive optimization.
Source reports an unexpected transfer of the CPB lens to a pre-existing playlist taxonomy and explicitly says this does not establish CPB correctness.
Source interprets the transfer as a shift from object/aesthetic categories to induced process trajectories.
Proposes a possible domain-general process-taxonomy principle while retaining the explicit non-validation qualifier.
Synthesizes bottleneck relocation, process classification, transformation invariants and the recursive claim that systems improve by improving mechanisms of improvement.
Source says the strongest demonstrated CPB capability is currently reframing/navigation rather than prediction.
Proposes CPB as a possible cognitive/navigation interface, high-value interactions as search transformations and trajectory-based cross-domain abstraction.
Proposes trajectory/attractor coherence and authenticity as predictive properties of dynamical systems.
Relates trajectory coherence to CPB and playlist taxonomy without establishing identity or dependency.
Proposes authenticity as negative divergence between internal and behavioral distributions and explicitly does not claim an established measurement.

program_references.content: R03 source surfaces describe conceptual/developmental relationships among Causal Mass, IICG and CPB. Exact program endpoints are not resolved from atlas knowledge.
